displayName: sedaia-api: Cloud Run p95 latency above two seconds

documentation.content: Symptom: Cloud Run p95 request latency exceeded two seconds for ten minutes. Inspect service and revision metrics and logs for sedaia-api in us-central1. First checks: inspect revision latency, instance scaling, and downstream calls. Roll back when the active revision introduced sustained latency. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.

conditions.displayName: p95 latency above two seconds for ten minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_latencies" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="sedaia-api" AND resource.label.location="us-central1"
